## OwnCode v0.2.0

This release adds global skill installation, improves the interface during parallel agent work, and upgrades Jev compaction.

### Skills from repositories

```bash
owncode add @owner/repo
owncode add https://github.com/owner/repo --skill review-go
```

- Install skills into `~/.owncode/skills` without opening the interface or connecting a model.
- Select installed skills with `@` in the message field.
- Discover shared skills through symlinks in `~/.agents/skills` and `~/.agent/skills`.
- Preserve the existing `$skill-name` syntax and `/skills` management commands.
- Keep installation scripts unexecuted and reject conflicting skill names before installation starts.

### More responsive parallel agent sessions

- Load conversation history and sidebar data asynchronously.
- Render large message bodies in the background.
- Reject stale render results after size or theme changes.
- Coalesce message snapshots while preserving lifecycle events for slow subscribers.
- Prevent a completed agent from waiting indefinitely for a result reader.
- Reuse loaded history when recalling messages in the editor.

### Jev compaction

- Upgrade Compact Engine from v0.2.0 to [v0.3.0](https://github.com/muratmirgun/compact-engine/releases/tag/v0.3.0).
- Score batches with two concurrent requests and explicit request limits.
- Include chronological tool information in scoring context.
- Shorten eligible read results independently while preserving call records, attachments, and protected results.
- Show reduction counts, protected groups, request counts, and scoring duration.
- Add **Settings → Context → Jev summary fallback**, disabled by default. When enabled, insufficient Jev reductions can use the configured summary model.

### Install or upgrade

```bash
brew update
brew install muratmirgun/tap/owncode
# If already installed:
brew upgrade owncode
```

You can also use the [download installer](https://github.com/muratmirgun/owncode#installation) or the release archives below.
Archives support macOS and Linux on arm64 and x86_64. Debian and RPM packages are also included.
Verify downloaded assets with `checksums.txt`.

### Validation and limits

The full Go race suite and vet checks passed. Installer tests and GoReleaser configuration checks also passed.
Compaction tests used local fixtures. Synthetic latency measurements do not predict live provider throughput.
Jev remains experimental. Protected context can still prevent a requested token target.
The optional summary fallback sends another model request and can incur provider costs.

**Full changes:** https://github.com/muratmirgun/owncode/compare/v0.1.0...v0.2.0
